name: kanban_subtask
description: Add, tick or remove a subtask on a card. Use op subtask_add with text, or subtask_toggle / subtask_remove with subtask_id.
llm_description: Add/toggle/remove a card subtask. op: subtask_add (with text), subtask_toggle or subtask_remove (with subtask_id); done sets explicit state for subtask_toggle.

subtask_id.description: Subtask id, for toggle and remove

room.description: Board room name; omit for the default 'board' room
